annotations.title: Operating Authority Sentinel: carrier compliance lookup

description: Use this when you need a one-call check of a US motor carrier before tendering a load. For 1 to 10 USDOT numbers: operating authority per docket, insurance on file, each suspension notice and insurance cancellation effective date, and the MCS-150 biennial update deadline with the FMCSA's current enforcement, merged into one list of deadlines sorted by date with days left. States and dates only. No personal data. Not a consumer report under the FCRA. Price: 0.012 USDC per call (x402).
name: carrier_compliance_lookup

data.description: The six datasets read live and the only fields used

disclaimer.description: Not legal advice; not affiliated with the FMCSA; not a consumer report

enforcement.description: What the FMCSA says it enforces for the biennial update, quoted

licence.description: Licence of the source data: nom, url, source (attribution if required)

note.description: How to read both blocks; which FMCSA records to check before acting

results.description: One entry per USDOT number: usdot_number; authority (exactly the /v1/authority entry for the number); biennial_update (usdot_status, operation, covered_by_390_19T, as_of, time_zone, filing_month, filing_years, last_deadline, next_deadline, days_to_next_deadline, last_mcs150_update, overdue, overdue_reason, deactivation_exposure, enforcement_for_last_deadline); as_of_differs_between_blocks; deadlines (kind: suspension_notice, insurance_cancellation or biennial_update; date; days_left; as_of; time_zone; enforcement for the biennial update), sorted by date

rules.description: Rules applied by both blocks, with official URL, status and block
